[Colors] Deep maroon #6E0D14 background, candy red #D8382F, cream #F7EBD8 panel, pine #2C5C3C, gold #D9A94C, muted pastel accents. [Layout] A hero band with clay trees standing on a curved red ledge, then a cream panel of stacked red price rows with folded ribbon ends, a large numeral at the bottom left, a contact strip footer. [Typography] Bold slab serif headline in cream, small tracked sans for the rows, an oversized serif numeral with a tiny superscript. [Subject] Three soft-clay stylised spruces strung with pastel bulbs, a tiny clay cottage with a red roof, a snub-nosed snowman, floating snow dots, and one small round badge above the headline. [Lighting & mood] Warm soft-box light, toy-like but premium, spa calm. [Details] Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "$399", "50% OFF". Rounded bevels, soft shadows, faint clay fingerprint texture.

title: Christmas Live Stream Overlay Banner Set
prompt: Professional Christmas live-stream overlay banner set, vertical, flat vector e-commerce cartoon. [Colors] crimson #B3181F with warm red #E23A2E, gold #F2C14E, cream #FFF0D6, small green #2E6B3E. [Layout] three-part frame: a festive header strip with a drawn stage, red curtain valance, spotlit riser, Santa sleigh at the left and gift pile plus tree at the right; a large empty white centre for the video feed; a footer strip holding three rounded coupon cards with perforated edges. [Typography] bold outlined display for the header, compact sans on the cards, tab labels in small caps. [Subject] illustrated Santa in a sleigh, wrapped parcels, decorated fir, candy canes, streamers and string lights. [Lighting & mood] cheerful, high-contrast, promotional energy. [Details] dotted light garlands, soft shadows, clean icon shapes. Text: "CHRISTMAS LIVE", "¥100 COUPON", "BUY 3 GET 1".

title: Clay Christmas Holiday Sale Poster
prompt: Christmas sale poster, vertical, matte air-dry clay with paper grain. [Colors] warm cream #F2E7D3 ground, tomato #D8402F, kelly green #3E9E5B, charcoal type, soft pink #F3C9C2. [Layout] a giant two-line block headline at the top with a small corner label, a green pill subheading, the hero cluster mid-page, three offer rows on a cream plate, contact line and QR code at the base. [Typography] ultra-heavy compressed sans, a rounded pill label, small bold sans for the offer lines. [Subject] a red gift box opened like a chest with a clay snowman bursting out, a clay apple with big eyes, a wrapped parcel, a baby bottle and a gingerbread man floating around it. [Lighting & mood] soft diffused studio light, matte ceramic finish, playful. [Details] text: "HOLIDAY SALE", "DEC 20 - JAN 3", "UP TO 40% OFF"; crumbly clay texture, tiny snow dots, bead-like highlights, faint speckle in the background.

title: Festive Christmas Restaurant Feast Promo Banner
prompt: Professional Christmas restaurant promo banner, horizontal, flat vector cartoon. [Colors] forest green #1F5B37, tomato red #D62828, marigold #F2B33D, snow white #FFFFFF. [Layout] header with a logo slot at the left, an oversized white display headline over a red Santa-hat shape, a gold-framed subline band, a character row across a snowy ground line, and a red footer band carrying the dates. [Typography] heavy condensed sans with white fill for the headline, small gold capitals for the offer line, tight sans for the dates. [Subject] waving cartoon Santa with a megaphone, cheerful reindeer, wrapped gift boxes, a decorated fir with a star, string lights and hanging stars along the top edge. [Lighting & mood] playful, loud, family-friendly. [Details] bold outlines, flat shading, snow-bank silhouette, no gradients. Text: "CHRISTMAS FEAST", "DEC 24–25", "GIFT WITH PURCHASE".

title: Holiday Free Gift with Any Order
prompt: Professional holiday retail cover, vertical, cut-out collage on glitter. [Colors] warm red #E2453F to coral #F07E6C gradient, fine gold glitter #E4B95A, cream white product cards, sage green #8FA98A hints. [Layout] headline at the top with a small ribbon tag under it, loose gold glitter forming a sparse tree silhouette in the centre, product packshots scattered diagonally through it, mascots anchored bottom-left and bottom-right. [Typography] heavy white sans headline with a thin underline swash, small caps for the tag line. [Subject] floating cosmetic bottles and boxes, candy cane, knitted stocking, gingerbread man, waving Santa figurine, gold sparkle trail. [Lighting & mood] bright commercial daylight, sparkle everywhere, gifting excitement. [Details] cut-out shadows, scattered snowflakes and stars, bokeh dots, clean product edges. Text: "HOLIDAY FREE GIFT", "WITH ANY ORDER".

title: Holiday Gift Season Sale Poster
prompt: Professional holiday sale poster, vertical, bold flat vector graphics. [Colors] signal red #D62828 background, forest green #1B6B4A blocks, sunflower yellow #FFC93C price table, pure white type accents. [Layout] angled headline stacked across the top, a rounded white banner beneath, a green callout block with a gift sack at upper right, a large yellow price table of dashed rows across the lower half, QR block at the base. [Typography] extra-bold italic sans with tight leading, slightly skewed for speed; numerals very heavy and oversized. [Subject] flat sack of presents, brass bells on a sprig, cartoon hand holding them, small tree and star icons. [Lighting & mood] punchy retail loudness, no shadows, high contrast, urgent. [Details] sticker-style white outlines, torn-paper edges, subtle halftone texture. Text: "HOLIDAY GIFT SEASON", "SPEND 300, SAVE 50", "GROUP EXTRA".

title: Holiday Gift Set Product Drop Poster
prompt: Professional holiday product-drop poster, vertical, glossy product still life. [Colors] deep burgundy #6E0F1A, glossy gift red #C1121F, champagne gold #D9AE5F, silver #D6D9DD. [Layout] logo slot and greeting at the top, a bordered announcement plate in the upper middle with a fine keyline and a small star divider, a stepped stack of wrapped boxes filling the lower half, contact row at the very bottom. [Typography] wide-tracked serif capitals for the greeting, hairline serif numerals inside the plate, small sans for the fine print. [Subject] stepped pile of red, plaid and polka-dot wrapped parcels with satin bows and gold cord, snowflake confetti drifting across the frame. [Lighting & mood] rich, festive, boutique retail glamour. [Details] glossy paper reflections, deep shadows between boxes, subtle vignette. Text: "HOLIDAY GIFT SET", "DEC 23 · 7PM".

title: Luxurious Paper-Cut Christmas Sale Poster
prompt: Professional Christmas sale poster, vertical, layered paper-cut with art deco symmetry. [Colors] two-tone green #0F5132 and #1B7A45 over oxblood #8E1B1B, metallic gold #D4A445. [Layout] strict split: the top 45 percent is a symmetrical paper tree of nested arcs with folded edges and a gold star apex, a narrow red channel running down its centre and a tiny framed window graphic mid-trunk; the lower half is a flat red field with a centred two-line headline, subline, hairline dash and a small-print footer row. [Typography] geometric sans with wide tracking for the headline, thin capitals for the footer. [Subject] folded paper fir silhouette with soft gradient shading and cast shadows. [Lighting & mood] studio-flat, precise, premium property tone. [Details] crisp paper edges, faint paper grain, generous negative space. Text: "CHRISTMAS SALE", "FROM 20% OFF", "ONE DAY ONLY".

title: Luxury Christmas Beauty Greeting Poster
prompt: Luxury beauty-brand Christmas greeting poster, vertical, velvet-and-gold paper-cut still life. [Colors] oxblood #7A0B12 graduating to crimson #A8121D, champagne gold #D9B36C, ivory highlights. [Layout] centred stack: gold script greeting at the top, a paper-cut stepped tree of five flat red terraces through the middle, a fine gold rule, a short serif wish below, a lipstick duo placed bottom left, QR bottom right. [Typography] engraved italic script with hairline swashes, small letterspaced serif for the wish. [Subject] an abstract tree — five isosceles tiers cut from red card, each holding a single glossy bauble: striped, plain gold, crimson, and one ruby etched with a snowflake. [Lighting & mood] low-key spotlight, glitter dust, intimate boutique elegance. [Details] flocked snowflake confetti, star flare, lens sparkle, deep edge vignette; text "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "HOLIDAY BEAUTY".
